purpose: Test whether latent race-level uncertainty can beat the deterministic L1.7 Plackett-Luce baseline before any market or ROI layer is introduced.

families.NORMAL_HOMO: Antithetic Normal noise on log horse strengths with one race-global sigma.
families.NORMAL_HETERO: Antithetic Normal noise on log horse strengths with horse-specific sigma scaled by seven-king disagreement.
families.STUDENTT_HETERO: Antithetic heavy-tailed Student-t noise on log horse strengths with horse-specific sigma scaled by seven-king disagreement.

selection.internal_calibration: Chronological last 20 percent of prior-only training races.
selection.metric: Official winning TRIFECTA negative log probability; exacta and trio retained as diagnostics.
